intro: You can learn how to ux research more effectively by automating the heavy lifting of your documentation and reporting. Many researchers spend up to 50 percent of their project time on administrative tasks instead of actual analysis.

Use AI-powered transcription tools to cut down on manual note-taking.

Focus your energy on synthesis rather than manual data entry.

blocks.text: The hidden costs of manual documentation

Manual documentation is a silent drain on your research capacity. When you spend hours copying data from Zoom transcripts into a spreadsheet, you lose time that could be spent on deep analysis. This fragmentation leads to knowledge silos where team members cannot find past insights. You end up repeating research because the original findings are buried in a folder labeled finalFINAL.
Why research documentation becomes a bottleneck

The core issue is a lack of standardization. Without a clear system, every project starts from scratch. You spend time setting up folders, creating consent forms, and drafting email templates for every single study. This administrative load is often unavoidable when teams lack dedicated ResearchOps support. It forces you to switch between deep analytical work and mundane data management, which kills your focus.
Fixes anyone can use without buying tools

items: Create a master template folder on your Mac that includes subfolders for raw data, transcripts, and synthesis notes.
Use Apple Shortcuts to generate project folders and pre-filled documents with a single click.
Establish a naming convention for all research assets and stick to it strictly.
Draft your interview scripts in a consistent format so you can easily copy and paste them into your analysis tool.
Follow your company policy for handling sensitive user data and PII.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you document faster

Lazur helps you stay in the flow by acting as your voice-based research assistant. You can keep your hands on your keyboard and your eyes on your data while you ask for help. Lazur sees your screen to point out where tools are or to guide you through complex setups.

faq.question: Is it safe to use AI for research documentation?
faq.answer: Always follow your employer guidelines regarding client or patient data. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio, but ensure your company permits the use of AI tools for your specific research projects.

faq.question: How do I start automating my research workflow?
faq.answer: Begin by identifying the most repetitive part of your day, such as folder creation or email drafting. Use a tool like Apple Shortcuts or simple templates to standardize these tasks before moving to more complex integrations.
